headline: Radisson Mining Resources Closes Strategic Investment with Agnico Eagle
summary: Radisson Mining Resources Inc. has finalized its previously announced private placement with Agnico Eagle Mines Limited, securing C$57.2 million to fund exploration at the O'Brien Gold Project.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. Issues Shares Following Employee Option Exercises
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. has issued 22,230 common shares to employees following the exercise of vested share options.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Announces Investor Day Webcast on September 16, 2026
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. will host an Investor Day webcast on September 16, 2026, featuring presentations from the company's executive team and partners.

headline: Gold.com Reports Fiscal Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2026 Financial Results
summary: Gold.com, Inc. announced its financial results for the fiscal fourth quarter and full year ended June 30, 2026.

headline: Liberty Gold Announces Black Pine Feasibility Study
summary: Liberty Gold released a feasibility study for its Black Pine project, which includes a 0.5% net smelter return royalty held by Wheaton Precious Metals Corp.

headline: Ewan Downie Appointed as Advisor to Discovery Mining Ltd.
summary: Discovery Mining Ltd. announced the appointment of Ewan Downie, the founder and former CEO of i-80 Gold Corp., as an Advisor to the President, CEO, and Chairman.

headline: Agnico Eagle Mines Agrees to Sell Mining Claims and Gold Project for $23.2 Million
summary: Agnico Eagle Mines Limited has agreed to divest certain mining claims and a gold project for a total consideration of $23.2 million.

headline: Silvercorp Metals Receives Second Installment from Wheaton Precious Metals for El Domo Project
summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. received a US$43.9 million payment from Wheaton Precious Metals as part of a previously established stream financing agreement for the El Domo mine project.

headline: 10% Shareholder of Gold.com, Inc. Acquires $3.93 Million in Common Stock
summary: A major shareholder, Tether Global Investments Fund, S.I.C.A.F., S.A., purchased 100,000 shares of Gold.com, Inc. common stock.

headline: Gold.com Insider Sells Shares Worth $313,458
summary: An insider at Gold.com, Inc. sold company shares valued at $313,458, according to a recent SEC filing.

headline: Gold.com Dividend Eligibility and Financial Performance Analysis
summary: Gold.com, Inc. (NYSE: GOLD) has announced an upcoming dividend payment of US$1.20 per share, with an eligibility deadline of September 16, 2026.

headline: Minerals 260 Agrees to a Further $143 Million Funding Package With Franco-Nevada
summary: Franco-Nevada has entered into a new A$200 million (approximately US$143.4 million) funding package with Minerals 260 to support the Bullabulling gold project.

headline: AngloGold Ashanti Completes Geochemical Program at Golden Eagle Project
summary: AngloGold Ashanti has completed a soil geochemistry sampling program at the Golden Eagle gold project as part of its ongoing farm-in agreement with EcoGraf Limited.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Participates in $200 Million Bought Deal Financing for Generation Mining's Marathon Project
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals is a participant in a $200 million bought deal financing to support the construction of Generation Mining Limited's Marathon Copper-Palladium Project.

headline: Agnico Eagle Declines Participation in Barrick Gold's North American IPO
summary: Agnico Eagle Mines Limited has publicly stated it has no interest in participating in a potential initial public offering of Barrick Gold's North American assets.

headline: Gold.com, Inc. Appoints Jill Van as Chief Financial Officer
summary: Gold.com, Inc. has announced the appointment of Jill Van as its new Chief Financial Officer, effective September 18, 2026.

headline: Gold.com, Inc. Announces CFO Transition and Appointment of New Auditor
summary: Gold.com, Inc. has appointed Jill Van as Chief Financial Officer, succeeding retiring CFO Cary Dickson, and named KPMG LLP as its new independent registered public accounting firm.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Participates in $25 Million Equity Investment for Luca Mining Transaction
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. has committed $25 million as a strategic equity shareholder to support a transaction involving Luca Mining.

headline: Wheaton Precious Metals Secures Additional Streaming Agreement for Cozamin Mine
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. has entered into an additional streaming agreement with Luca Mining, providing $25 million in capital for the Cozamin mine in exchange for an incremental 15% of refined silver production.

headline: i-80 Gold Corp. Reports Initial Drill Results from Mineral Point Project
summary: i-80 Gold Corp. announced positive initial drill results from its 2026 infill drilling campaign at the Mineral Point open pit heap leach project in Nevada.

headline: i-80 Gold Corp. Announces Feasibility Study Results for Granite Creek Underground
summary: i-80 Gold Corp. released a feasibility study for its Granite Creek Underground project, reporting an after-tax NPV(5%) of $118 million at a gold price of $2,750 per ounce.

headline: Gold.com Insider Executes Share Sale
summary: An insider at Gold.com, Inc. sold shares valued at approximately $1.74 million, as disclosed in a recent SEC filing.

headline: Grafton Resources Enters Option Agreement to Acquire Poseidon and Jabali Projects from Newmont
summary: Grafton Resources has entered into an exclusive option agreement to acquire 100% of the Poseidon gold-silver-copper project and the Jabali gold project in Chile from Newmont Corporation.

headline: Franco-Nevada Subscribes for 10 Million Shares in Banyan Gold Corp. Financing
summary: Franco-Nevada Corporation has subscribed for 10 million shares of Banyan Gold Corp. as part of a previously announced private placement and concurrent offering.

headline: AngloGold Ashanti Hosts Investor Site Visit to Nevada's Beatty Gold District
summary: AngloGold Ashanti is hosting a site visit for institutional investors and analysts to provide an update on the development of its Beatty Mining District in southern Nevada.

headline: i-80 Gold Corp. Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report
summary: i-80 Gold Corp. released its 2025 Sustainability Report and Databook, detailing progress in environmental, social, and governance initiatives.

headline: Franco-Nevada CEO Paul Brink Appointed Chair of World Gold Council
summary: Franco-Nevada Corporation announced that its President and CEO, Paul Brink, has been appointed as the Chair of the World Gold Council.

headline: Franco-Nevada Becomes Shareholder in Banyan Gold Corp.
summary: Franco-Nevada Corporation has become a new shareholder in Banyan Gold Corp. following the latter's closing of a $54.3 million financing round.
